title: Proapoptotic Effect and Molecular Docking Analysis of Curcumin-Resveratrol Hybrids in Colorectal Cancer Chemoprevention.
authors: Moreno-Q, Gustavo; Herrera-R, Angie; Yepes, Andres F; Naranjo, Tonny W; Cardona-G, Wilson
one_liner_zh: 该文研究姜黄素-白藜芦醇杂合物的促凋亡作用及与caspase/MMP7/p53蛋白的分子对接，虽含分子对接但对象为小分子-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Different hybrids based on curcumin and resveratrol were previously synthesized and characterized by spectroscopic techniques. The most active molecules (3a, 3e, 3i, and 3k) were evaluated in vitro as an approach to determine the possible mechanism of action of the hybrids. The results indicated that the evaluated curcumin/resveratrol hybrids induce mitochondrial instability in SW620 and SW480 cells. Moreover, these molecules caused a loss in membrane integrity, suggesting an apoptotic process mediated by caspases after the treatment with compounds 3i (SW480) and 3k (SW620). In addition, the results suggest that the mechanism of action of the hybrids could be independent of the p53 status. Furthermore, hybrids 3e and 3i caused G0/G1 phase arrest, which highlights the potential of these molecules not only as cytotoxic but also as cytostatic compounds. Hybrids 3e and 3i caused a negative modulation of the matrix metalloproteinase 7 (MMP7) on SW480 cells. These curcumin resveratrol hybrids could be potential candidates for further investigations in the search for potential chemopreventive agents, even in those cases with resistance to conventional chemotherapy because of the lack of p53 expression or function. Molecular docking simulations showed that compounds 3e, 3i, and 3k bind efficiently to proapoptotic human caspases 3/7 proteins, as well as human MMP-7 and p53, which, in turn, could explain at the molecular level the in vitro cytotoxic effect of these compounds in SW480 and SW620 colon cancer cell lines.
abstract_zh: 基于姜黄素和白藜芦醇的不同杂合体先前已被合成并通过光谱技术进行表征。最活跃的分子（3a、3e、3i 和 3k）在体外进行了评估，以探讨这些杂合体可能的机制。结果表明，所评估的姜黄素/白藜芦醇杂合体在 SW620 和 SW480 细胞中诱导线粒体不稳定。此外，这些分子导致膜完整性丧失，提示在化合物 3i（SW480）和 3k（SW620）处理后，存在由半胱天冬酶介导的凋亡过程。另外，结果提示这些杂合体的作用机制可能不依赖于 p53 状态。进一步地，杂合体 3e 和 3i 引起 G0/G1 期阻滞，这突显了这些分子不仅具有细胞毒性，还具有细胞静止性潜力。杂合体 3e 和 3i 在 SW480 细胞中对基质金属蛋白酶 7（MMP7）产生负向调节。这些姜黄素-白藜芦醇杂合体可能成为进一步研究潜在化学预防剂的候选物，即使在因缺乏 p53 表达或功能而对常规化疗产生耐药的情况下也是如此。分子对接模拟显示，化合物 3e、3i 和 3k 能有效结合促凋亡的人半胱天冬酶 3/7 蛋白，以及人 MMP-7 和 p53，这可能在分子水平上解释了这些化合物在 SW480 和 SW620 结肠癌细胞系中的体外细胞毒性效应。
